SOUND RECORDED WITH THIS PERFORMANCE: record a continuous eight-second production soundtrack with quiet workshop air audible throughout. At second2, Erin gives one clearly audible warm nonverbal chuckle, timed to her smile and small chest movement; Claire is still tense and quiet. At second4.5, Claire sees Erin smiling and gives one clearly audible relieved outward breath as her shoulders lower and her smile arrives. These are two distinct, separated vocal events from the pictured women, recorded at normal conversational audibility above the low room sound. Keep the intervening and final room sound continuous through second8. Wordless human reactions only: no dialogue, whispering, music or background speakers. 

The camera moves physically0.6m to the right over the full8seconds along the front side of the axis, Same fixed35mm lens look, no zoom, no cut or axis crossing. Both people remain visible and their faces readable. The tabletop and distant shelf show different parallax speeds. In both A/B use this exact same camera instruction. The letter stays still, hands remain separate. The sound follows the staggered breaths and chuckle described above, with no spoken words.

Erin notices first, exhales and smiles during seconds1–3. Claire remains visibly concerned and unsmiling through the first3seconds. Only after noticing Erin's reaction around4seconds does Claire relax and smile. Hold their staggered emotional states long enough to read, then settle together. No synchronized nods or extra dialogue.
START FRAME: the supplied photographic frame is the literal starting image. Preserve its two actors, connected table, shelf, wardrobe and letter while executing the camera and staggered reactions described above.
